#nullable enable
using System.Net.Http;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Reflection;

namespace __RUNTIME_NAMESPACE__.Sse;

public abstract class SseEndPointClient
{
    public string Path { get; }
    public string BaseUrl { get; }
    public HttpClient Client { get; }
    public bool AutoReconnect { get; set; } = true;
    public TimeSpan ReconnectDelay { get; set; } = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);

    protected SseEndPointClient(string path, HttpClient? client = null, string? baseUrl = null)
    {
        Path = path;
        BaseUrl = baseUrl?.TrimEnd('/') ?? "";
        Client = client ?? new HttpClient();
    }

    public async IAsyncEnumerable<SseMessage> ListenAsync(
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        while (true)
        {
            cancellationToken.ThrowIfCancellationRequested();
            {
                await using var reader = ReadOnceAsync(cancellationToken).GetAsyncEnumerator(cancellationToken);
                while (true)
                {
                    bool hasMessage;
                    try
                    {
                        hasMessage = await reader.MoveNextAsync();
                    }
                    catch (Exception error) when (AutoReconnect && IsTransient(error, cancellationToken))
                    {
                        break;
                    }
                    if (!hasMessage) break;
                    yield return reader.Current;
                }
            }
            if (!AutoReconnect) yield break;
            await Task.Delay(ReconnectDelay, cancellationToken);
        }
    }

    private static bool IsTransient(Exception error, CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        if (cancellationToken.IsCancellationRequested) return false;
        return error switch
        {
            HttpRequestException request => request.StatusCode is null ||
                (int)request.StatusCode >= 500 ||
                request.StatusCode is System.Net.HttpStatusCode.RequestTimeout or
                    System.Net.HttpStatusCode.TooManyRequests,
            IOException => true,
            OperationCanceledException => true,
            _ => false
        };
    }

    private async IAsyncEnumerable<SseMessage> ReadOnceAsync(
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken)
    {
        using var request = new HttpRequestMessage(HttpMethod.Get, BaseUrl + Path);
        request.Headers.Accept.ParseAdd("text/event-stream");
        using var response = await Client.SendAsync(request, HttpCompletionOption.ResponseHeadersRead, cancellationToken);
        response.EnsureSuccessStatusCode();
        await using var stream = await response.Content.ReadAsStreamAsync(cancellationToken);
        using var reader = new StreamReader(stream, Encoding.UTF8);
        var lines = new StringBuilder();
        while (await reader.ReadLineAsync(cancellationToken) is { } line)
        {
            if (line.Length == 0)
            {
                if (lines.Length > 0)
                {
                    var raw = lines.ToString();
                    lines.Clear();
                    using var document = JsonDocument.Parse(raw);
                    var envelope = document.RootElement;
                    var channel = envelope.GetProperty("channel").GetString() ?? "";
                    var data = envelope.GetProperty("data").GetString() ?? "";
                    yield return new SseMessage(channel, data);
                }
            }
            else if (line.StartsWith("data:", StringComparison.Ordinal))
            {
                if (lines.Length > 0) lines.Append('\n');
                lines.Append(line.AsSpan(5).TrimStart());
            }
        }
    }
}

public sealed record SseMessage(string Channel, string Data);

public abstract class SseEventClient<T>(SseEndPointClient endpoint, string topic)
{
    private static readonly Type? JsonConvert = Type.GetType("Newtonsoft.Json.JsonConvert, Newtonsoft.Json");
    private static readonly MethodInfo? DeserializeMethod = JsonConvert?.GetMethods(BindingFlags.Public | BindingFlags.Static)
        .FirstOrDefault(method => method.Name == "DeserializeObject" && method.IsGenericMethodDefinition &&
            method.GetParameters().Length == 1 && method.GetParameters()[0].ParameterType == typeof(string));
    public SseEndPointClient EndPoint { get; } = endpoint;
    public string Topic { get; } = topic;

    public async IAsyncEnumerable<T?> ListenAsync(
        [EnumeratorCancellation] CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        await foreach (var message in EndPoint.ListenAsync(cancellationToken))
        {
            if (message.Channel != Topic) continue;
            yield return DeserializeMethod == null
                ? JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(message.Data,
                    new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true })
                : (T?)DeserializeMethod.MakeGenericMethod(typeof(T)).Invoke(null, [message.Data]);
        }
    }
}
